reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Generative AI superseding human skills
themes.definition: Generative AI as progress that supersedes rather than optimizes human skills, with potentially tragic labour-market consequences.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on AI replacing human skills or jobs and consequences for the labour market.
themes.exclusion: Exclude productivity-gain framings without displacement concern.
themes.boundary_cases: Displacement tied to wealth concentration is also coded AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: progress no longer optimizes human skills but supersedes them, with potentially tragic consequences, especially for the labour market

themes.label: Wealth concentrating at the top
themes.definition: AI-driven change concentrating wealth among a few.
themes.inclusion: Include claims that AI will concentrate wealth or power.
themes.exclusion: Exclude between-country access gaps without concentration language.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief concentration clauses in labour arguments are coded both themes.

examples.quote: with wealth becoming even more concentrated at the top

themes.label: G7 push for balanced global AI governance
themes.definition: Using a G7 presidency to help define global AI governance balancing innovation, rights, labour, IP, free expression and democracy.
themes.inclusion: Include pledges to shape global AI governance through G7 or other forums.
themes.boundary_cases: Balance lists naming rights and democracy also support AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: defining a global governance for artificial intelligence that is able to strike a balance among innovation, rights, labour, intellectual property, freedom of expression and democracy

themes.label: Questioning whether AI is intelligence
themes.definition: Philosophical scepticism about calling data-processing systems 'intelligence', since intelligence entails asking questions.
themes.inclusion: Include passages reflecting on the nature of machine intelligence versus human intelligence.
themes.exclusion: Exclude ethics or rights claims that do not discuss what intelligence is.
themes.boundary_cases: Claims that 'no algorithm can replace human conscience' are ethics (AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS) unless they define intelligence.

examples.quote: Intelligence entails asking questions, not answering them through data-processing.

value.rationale: A single Italy 2024 passage treats generative AI as a revolution displacing human skills and concentrating wealth, questions its status as intelligence, and presents G7 leadership on balanced global governance.
